validation_rule: next asset in fixed cyclic order after outer test asset
threshold_rule: validation only; maximize episode recall, then minimize false alarm rate, then maximize point precision, then maximize threshold
candidate_rule: validation only; maximize episode recall, minimize false alarm rate, maximize point precision; exact tie favors logistic
negative_policy: annotated normal interval, complete observed 24-hour future, competing anchors censored
positive_policy: canonical failure anchor only, (t,t+24h], competing faults censored
unknown_policy: exclude from fitting and point metrics; retain warnings and prediction availability in outputs
episode_denominator: all 11 canonical faults, including faults with no eligible predictions
deployment: offline experiment only; no production model selected using outer test scores
